_comment: Janus agent configuration (Personal). Restart the agent after editing.

Clipboard._comment_OutboundMode: Manual = local copies stay local until you trigger a push. Auto = auto-broadcast on every change.

Push._comment: Manual clipboard-push triggers. Push sends THIS PC's clipboard to the peer (same effect as pressing the clipboard key in the controller).
Push._comment_ConsoleKey: Single key, pressed in THIS agent's own console window, that triggers a push. Case-insensitive.
Push._comment_Hotkey: Global hotkey (works from any window). Disabled by default. Set HotkeyEnabled true and pick modifiers + key. Key is a single character A-Z or 0-9.

Switch._comment: Triggers that switch the active target to the OTHER PC. Sends 'SWITCH PEER' to the controller, which performs the switch.
Switch._comment_ConsoleKey: Single key, pressed in THIS agent's own console window, that requests a switch.
Switch._comment_Hotkey: Global hotkey for switching. NOTE: Ctrl+Shift+S is 'Save As' in many apps (Word, browsers). While the agent runs, this hotkey takes precedence over those app-level bindings.
